title: 3 React Tricks Few Devs Know
sub: One works in any version. Two need React 19.
intro: 3 React tricks that remove a lot of boilerplate.

tricks.title: Reset with key
tricks.note: Change the key and React resets all state inside. No useEffect.

tricks.title: ref is just a prop
tricks.note: Function components get ref as a normal prop. No forwardRef.

tricks.title: <title> anywhere
tricks.note: Render <title> or <meta> in any component. React moves it to <head>.

caption:
3 React tricks that remove a lot of boilerplate.

1. Change a component's key to reset its state
2. React 19: ref is a normal prop, no forwardRef
3. React 19: <title> and <meta> in any component go to <head>

Are you on React 19 yet?

Send this to the dev who still writes forwardRef.
